cases.expect: A replacement source with the same path but a new generation invalidates old part provenance.
A different committed fingerprint cannot restore old part ownership.
Canvas dimensions or part-layout identity mismatch rejects restoration.
Duplicate zone UUIDs are ambiguous and cannot be rebound to saved ownership.
Duplicate edit keys cannot cause one saved owner to bind to multiple live zones.
Renamed, hidden, muted, or expired provenance is not trusted as current editable ownership.
A changed region mask rejects restoration even if the old provenance field is forged/preserved.
A commit from another operation/document cannot consume the saved owner.
Without CAR.maskFor and explicit proof callback, restoration fails closed.
Matching document/layout/mask and unique exact owner restores only the intended owner.
After valid restore, finish-only mutation updates the same owner and leaves color/mask intact.
Stored snapshot cannot be mutated by caller; trusted proof callbacks are invoked under documented constraints.

results.actual: accepts a new runtime generation for identical canonical path/fingerprint/dimensions with current proofs
results.oracleConflict: W30 expected unconditional invalidation; this conflicts with W18 documented same-content rebind policy.

results.executionLimit: prototype has no proAI finish-only route; modeled object update only

reviewFindings.issue: Prototype requires a proof.partMaskCurrent callback, but the existing production partOwnerCurrent checks p.p only conditionally when CAR.maskFor exists. Integration must provide an explicit unconditional CAR.maskFor-backed check and post-stage full owner proof; callbacks in this test are deterministic doubles, not production validators.

reviewFindings.where: paint-booth-2-state-zones.js: getConfig around 16033-16278 and loadConfigFromObj around 16303-16356; js/features/spb-projects.js:193-216, 450-485
reviewFindings.issue: Durable state is not wired: getConfig serializes explicit fields and masks but omits _aiPartProv/aiPartMemory; load materializes zones with regionMask:null and omits provenance; project capture stores this config. Prototype cannot provide persistence until the staged decode/verified-source hook is added.

The module rejects muted/renamed but does not inspect a hidden/visible flag or encode expiry. It delegates current validity to trusted callbacks; integration must make those callbacks reject every actual inactive-owner state and define whether proof freshness is source/content-bound rather than time-bound.

reviewFindings.where: js/spb-ai-part-memory.js: currentProof and prepareRestore calls to countOwners
reviewFindings.issue: UUID uniqueness is not internally checked; countOwners(key, zone.id) is trusted to enforce unique selector owner and stable-ID uniqueness. Integration callback must count both ID and key ambiguities, not only matching-key owners.

Records are detached copies and input objects remain unchanged, but returned record/provenance objects are mutable plain JSON. Treat as caller-owned serialization values; freeze/deep-freeze if API promises immutable snapshots.

limits: Controlled proof callbacks implement source/owner/mask semantics for unit tests only; they do not validate actual CAR.maskFor or partOwnerCurrent integration.
The finish-only mutation check is metadata/mask preservation only; the module is uninstalled and has no production finish route.
W18 serialization report was used as the source-context guide; current source hashes recorded separately, with no serializer/project file edits.
No native application, renderer, provider, browser, project save/load, or external I/O was exercised.
